black_injector.name: Synaprest Injector
black_injector.shortDescription: Next-generation treatment for drug addiction, designed to suppress the brain's reward system, reduce cravings, and support long-term recovery
black_injector.flavorText: Works best with concurrent psychological therapy and social support.

pink_injector.name: Oxymore Injector
pink_injector.shortDescription: Oxymore is a legal, but dangerous medication used to relieve severe pain and produce feelings of euphoria. Oxymore addiction and overdose are widespread due to over-prescription.

pink_alt_injector.name: Nomore Injector
pink_alt_injector.shortDescription: A non-addictive alternative to Oxymore for pain relief. Provides effective analgesia without the risk of dependence or overdose. This one is a prototype packaged in a repurposed injector.

large_purple_injector.name: Immunivax Injector
large_purple_injector.shortDescription: A high-precision immuno-regulator developed to temporarily suppress the hyper-reactive immune response associated with Sentinel Collapse.

pure_white_injector.name: Naloxgone Injector
pure_white_injector.shortDescription: Naloxgone is a emergency medication used to counter Oxymore overdose.

birth_control_pill.name: Birth Control Pill
birth_control_pill.flavorText: A contraceptive pill that prevents pregnancy. It's a combination of estrogen and progestin hormones.

fanta_pill.name: Phanta Pill
fanta_pill.shortDescription: An extremely addictive, dangerous and cheap synthetic opioid drug used for treatment of severe pain.
fanta_pill.flavorText: More than 50 times stronger than Oxymore.

phagimycin_pill.name: Phagimycin Pill
phagimycin_pill.flavorText: A powerful antibiotic made with bacteriophages and fungi to counter antibiotic resistance.

unlicensed_phagimycin_pill.name: Unlicensed Phagimycin Pill
unlicensed_phagimycin_pill.flavorText: A powerful antibiotic. This one is made illegaly without license to the carmicheal's patent in an underground lab.

zyanide_pill.name: Zyanide Pill
zyanide_pill.shortDescription: A fast-acting and deadly chemical compound. Handle with caution.

smelling_salt.name: Smelling Salts
smelling_salt.shortDescription: A thin glass tube containing alcohol and ammonia that helps restore consciousness after fainting.

bandage_item.name: Basic Bandage
bandage_item.shortDescription: A simple, clean bandage for dressing wounds.

hemostatic_bandage_item.name: Hemostatic Bandage
hemostatic_bandage_item.shortDescription: A bandage coated with a potent hemostatic agent capable of stopping heavy and light bleeding.

topical_bandage_item.name: Topical Medication Bandage
topical_bandage_item.shortDescription: A bandage coated with a mild topical medical gel that aids in the healing process.

blood_bag.name: Blood Bag
blood_bag.shortDescription: A 500ml blood transfusion bag drawn from a universal, though not necessarily willing, donor.

blue_blood_bag.name: Bag of "Blue Blood"
blue_blood_bag.shortDescription: An injectable biogel engineered to dissolve arterial plaque and microclots over time. It effectively prevents coronary artery disease, ischemic stroke and hypertension-related complications.
blue_blood_bag.flavorText: It's not actually blood. Not so common even in the Upper Levels.

dream_dust.name: Vial of "Dream Dust"
dream_dust.flavorText: A cheap, euphoria inducing powder, created in the Lower Levels. Used as a brief escape from the harsh realities of Station life.

nightmare_dust.name: Vial of "Nightmare Dust"
nightmare_dust.flavorText: A fine powder that acts as both a poison and a hallucinogen. Ingestion or inhalation causes severe nausea, weakness, and disorientation, followed terrifying hallucinations. High doses can be lethal.

caffeine_pill.name: Caffeine Pill
caffeine_pill.flavorText: Synthesized from the waste of Upper Levels espresso bars, these pills are essential for the long shift workers of the Lower Levels.

salve.name: Nightingale's Salve
salve.flavorText: Made from modified aloe and medical grade honey. This salve has antibacterial properties and promotes cell regeneration and growth.

rubbing_alcohol.name: Rubbing Alcohol
rubbing_alcohol.flavorText: A potent disinfectant used for cleaning wounds and surfaces. Highly toxic if ingested, but that doesn't stop it being used as an alternative to Nudka in the Lower Levels.

zerochew.name: ZeroChew Tab
zerochew.shortDescription: A tab of ZeroChew, an affordable appetite suppressant.
zerochew.flavorText: Used by some Lower Levels inhabitants looking to stretch their credits by skipping meals. Marketed as Regime-X, a weight loss drug in the Upper Levels.

chem_scanner.name: Composition Spectrometer
chem_scanner.shortDescription: A device used to analyze the chemical composition of substances.

surgery_tool.name: Surgery Toolset
surgery_tool.flavorText: A set of high quality surgery tools.
